content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: JRF / Project Associate I: B.Tech/ B.E./ MSc or M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S. in Electrical Engineering/ Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Computer science/ or similar field or equivalent qualification with 60% marks (or 6 grade points out of 10). Applicants should have a valid GATE score or pass other National Eligibility Tests or National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Institutions. Applicants without GATE may be considered with lower Emoluments as per the Institute rules. Research Associate III: PhD with at least one research paper in Science Citation indexed (SCI) Journal. Note: PhD thesis submitted candidates can also apply.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Ropar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Ropar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar JRF / Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Ropar JRF / Project Associate-I recruitment is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF / Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the JRF / Project Associate-I and Research Associate III posts at IIT Ropar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the JRF / Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for JRF / Project Associate-I is B.Tech/B.E./MSc or M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in relevant fields with 60% marks and a valid GATE score or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for the IIT Ropar recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF / Project Associate-I and Research Associate III posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs.37000 +10% HRA, and Rs.67000 +10% HRA, depending on the position and qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. Does IIT Ropar offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a submitted PhD thesis apply for the Research Associate III position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis are eligible to apply for the Research Associate III position.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Ropar recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions at IIT Ropar is contractual.
